description: Approved differences between gtfs.guru and MobilityData/gtfs-validator on the pinned real-world corpus. An entry documents a difference the project has decided to accept or has not triaged yet; anything not listed here is a parity regression. Totals are pinned, so a difference that changes size loses its approval and resurfaces. Use "absent" when a validator does not emit the code at all, and omit a total to accept any value. See docs/real-world-parity.md.

entries.reason: Triaged 2026-09-15 (GTF-34). calendar.txt rows 12, 25, 29, 41 and 43 (service_ids 17, 47, 53, 340, 343) have every weekday set to 0 and no calendar_dates.txt additions, so the services never run. service_never_active has no canonical equivalent and is already an acknowledged addition in spec_baseline.json and spec_changes.json. Kept.
